Lingyi iTech.evidence: 2026 Half-Year Report: Readore's main business includes server liquid-cooling quick disconnects (UQD), liquid-cooling manifolds, single-phase liquid-cooling modules (server liquid cooling plates and optical-module cold plates) ... as a core supplier to a North American AI-compute leader, it delivers server liquid-cooling and power products in volume to leading overseas AI-compute companies, their supply-chain partners, server contract manufacturers and power-solution companies.
